title: The Trailblazer cover
slide_intent: Give an editorial object a distinct cover hierarchy because a reader must recognize its title before exploring its imagery.
strategic_value: A yellow frame and unusual lifestyle image can make a Mailchimp publication recognizable at a glance.
demonstration: A yellow publication cover hangs among leaves, with its title above a rectangular colorful image and small footer details.
practical_value: Compare title, image and brand color as separate levels of an editorial cover.

content_islands.name: Cover
content_islands.spec: Keep the title above the central image within the tilted yellow rectangle.

content_islands.name: Setting
content_islands.spec: Retain the surrounding green leaves and white wall as the physical presentation.

reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates a branded publication cover in a photographed setting.
